mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yan_cache_invalidation_outbox(task_key,cache_key,pattern_flag,status,retry_count,max_retry,next_retry_at,last_error,process_count,rerun_requested) VALUES(#{taskKey},#{cacheKey},#{patternFlag},'PENDING',0,#{maxRetry},NOW(3),#{reason},0,0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE cache_key=VALUES(cache_key),pattern_flag=VALUES(pattern_flag),retry_count=CASE WHEN status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED') THEN 0 ELSE retry_count END,next_retry_at=CASE WHEN status='PROCESSING' THEN next_retry_at ELSE NOW(3) END,locked_until=CASE WHEN status='PROCESSING' THEN locked_until ELSE NULL END,last_error=VALUES(last_error),dead_letter_at=NULL,rerun_requested=CASE WHEN status='PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,status=CASE WHEN status='PROCESSING' THEN status ELSE 'PENDING' END,update_time=NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM yan_cache_invalidation_outbox WHERE status='PENDING' AND next_retry_at <= NOW(3) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE yan_cache_invalidation_outbox SET status='PROCESSING',locked_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND),update_time=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING' AND next_retry_at <= NOW(3)
UPDATE yan_cache_invalidation_outbox SET process_count=process_count+1,last_process_at=NOW(3),update_time=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE yan_cache_invalidation_outbox SET status=CASE WHEN rerun_requested=1 THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'SUCCEEDED' END,locked_until=NULL,last_error=NULL,next_retry_at=CASE WHEN rerun_requested=1 THEN NOW(3) ELSE next_retry_at END,rerun_requested=0,update_time=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE yan_cache_invalidation_outbox SET status=CASE WHEN retry_count+1 >= max_retry THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END,next_retry_at=CASE WHEN retry_count+1 >= max_retry THEN next_retry_at ELSE DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL #{delaySeconds} SECOND) END,locked_until=NULL,last_error=#{reason},dead_letter_at=CASE WHEN retry_count+1 >= max_retry THEN NOW(3) ELSE dead_letter_at END,retry_count=retry_count+1,update_time=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE yan_cache_invalidation_outbox SET status='PENDING',locked_until=NULL,update_time=NOW(3) WHERE status='PROCESSING' AND locked_until < NOW(3)

UPDATE yan_cache_invalidation_outbox SET retry_count=CASE WHEN status='FAILED' THEN 0 ELSE retry_count END,status='PENDING',next_retry_at=NOW(3),locked_until=NULL,last_error=NULL,dead_letter_at=NULL,rerun_requested=0,update_time=NOW(3) WHERE status IN ('PENDING','FAILED')
